question: Under what condition should one grant the teaching that brings long life?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined
Examination should be done always carefully
Only then should the gift be given
inference: After thorough examination, one may give this teaching to such a person.
uncertainties: cirajīvitam may refer to the teaching or its result
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one should give to him that which brings long life.
